verdict.rationale: An AI-native forge could reasonably offer in-product AI insights such as PR summaries or review suggestions, so this axis applies. GitCafe's documented AI features don't do that: the MCP server, WebMCP, llms.txt/Markdown exports and the hand-off button all pass data to external agents (Claude, Codex, Cursor and others). These are adjacent integration features, not AI-generated insights or suggestions inside GitCafe itself, so they earn no credit.
